panel_metal.use: Main window body: inventory, campfire, any full-screen menu. Holds headers, slots and lists.
panel_metal.where: Screens. In the mocks: 672x300 at (24,19), centred under the tab row.
panel_metal.notes: Corner rivets live in the 6px corners. Lay content 8px in from the outer edge.

panel_plate.use: Small raised plate: HUD blocks, stat boxes, item detail card, belt backing, toasts, clock, quest card.
panel_plate.notes: Pad content 4-5px from the edge. Belt backing: 3px around the 10 hotbar slots.

panel_inset.use: Recessed tray that holds a grid or list: backpack grid, recipe list, campfire station, quantity box.
panel_inset.where: Inside windows, under groups of slots.
panel_inset.notes: Dark top/left edge, light bottom/right, so it reads as sunk in.

panel_paper.use: Notebook page for the selected recipe: icon, name, stats, needed ingredients, flavour text.
panel_paper.notes: Ruled lines every 8px from y=12, so tile the middle vertically in steps of 8. Put `tape` on top at x=6 and x=w-22, y=-2. Text on paper is near-black #0e0d11.

panel_tooltip.use: Hover tooltip for items, recipes and stats.
panel_tooltip.where: Follows the cursor, 8px right and below it, kept on screen.
panel_tooltip.notes: Silkscreen title in bone, Jersey 10 body, stat changes in rot green (+) or blood red (-).

tape.use: Duct tape strip that holds paper panels.
tape.where: Two per paper panel, overlapping its top edge by 2px.

header_plate.use: Section title bar: SURVIVOR, BACKPACK, CRAFTING, CAMPFIRE, RECIPES.
header_plate.where: Top of each column inside a window, full column width.
header_plate.notes: Height stays 14. Left 11px is the hazard stripe block, never stretch it. Title: Silkscreen Bold, bone, at (14,4) with a 1px olive shadow. Optional right-aligned counter (5/32) in Silkscreen at w-5.

tab_active.use: Window tabs: INVENTORY / JOURNAL / MAP / SKILLS.
tab_active.where: Row above the window, starting 8px in from its left edge, 1px apart.
tab_active.notes: Width = label width + 12. Label: Silkscreen Bold at (6,5), bone when active, grey #837d7f when idle. Tabs overlap the window top by 2px: under the active tab, paint over the window's top border with olive #3e4331 so it opens into the panel.

tab_idle.use: Window tabs: INVENTORY / JOURNAL / MAP / SKILLS.
tab_idle.where: Row above the window, starting 8px in from its left edge, 1px apart.
tab_idle.notes: Width = label width + 12. Label: Silkscreen Bold at (6,5), bone when active, grey #837d7f when idle. Tabs overlap the window top by 2px: under the active tab, paint over the window's top border with olive #3e4331 so it opens into the panel.

slot_empty.use: Inventory, equipment, recipe and station cells. Swap the whole sprite per state: hover = cursor over it, selected = picked or being dragged, locked = not unlocked yet (bag upgrades), warn = something wrong (broken item, missing fuel).
slot_empty.notes: Item icons (32x32 world sprites) are drawn at 1 screen px per sprite px, centred, so they fit the 40-screen-px slot with 4px to spare. Stack count: Silkscreen, bone with a near-black shadow, bottom-right at (n-2, n-8), right-aligned. Empty equipment slots can show a 9x9 icon in #423f46 as a ghost hint.

slot_hotbar.where: Bottom centre of the HUD, 25px pitch, on a panel_plate backing.
slot_hotbar.notes: Key number in Silkscreen, grey #5e5a60, at (3,3). Selected = the one in hand.

slot_hotbar_selected.where: Bottom centre of the HUD, 25px pitch, on a panel_plate backing.
slot_hotbar_selected.notes: Key number in Silkscreen, grey #5e5a60, at (3,3). Selected = the one in hand.

button_normal_idle.notes: Height 14 (13 for filter chips, 16 for the Craft/Cook bar). Label: Silkscreen, centred, 1px lower when pressed. Text bone on normal/danger, near-black on primary, #5e5a60 when disabled. An optional 9x9 icon sits 3px from the left. A pressed state also serves as 'toggled on' for filter chips.

bar_frame.use: Empty trough for every bar: HP, stamina, XP, quest progress, craft progress, fuel, load, condition.
bar_frame.notes: Any width; height 5-11 (HP 11, stamina 7, XP 6, small progress 5).

bar_fill_hp.use: Fill for the matching bar. hp red, stamina hazard yellow, hunger rust, thirst/temp cold blue, infection rot green, xp bone, fuel orange.
bar_fill_hp.notes: Tile horizontally (10px period, dark tick every 10px) and clip to value x inner width. For thin bars (5-6px) you can turn ticks off. HP damage tail: after a hit, draw the lost part in #ada59f for ~0.5s, then shrink it.

chip_frame.use: Square vital gauge: thirst, hunger, temperature, infection (and fuel). Warn version has a red rim for critical values.
chip_frame.notes: Build at runtime: frame, then a fill from the bottom of the 14x14 inside (height = 14 x value) in the kind's dark colour with a 1px mid-colour top line, then the 9x9 icon at (3,3) in bone with a 1px near-black shadow at (+1,+1). Switch to chip_frame_warn below 20% (or above 80% for infection).

chip_frame_warn.use: Square vital gauge: thirst, hunger, temperature, infection (and fuel). Warn version has a red rim for critical values.
chip_frame_warn.notes: Build at runtime: frame, then a fill from the bottom of the 14x14 inside (height = 14 x value) in the kind's dark colour with a 1px mid-colour top line, then the 9x9 icon at (3,3) in bone with a 1px near-black shadow at (+1,+1). Switch to chip_frame_warn below 20% (or above 80% for infection).

clock.use: Day counter, time and day/night track.
clock.where: HUD top-right, 6px from the edges (in the mock: 110 wide at x=604).
clock.notes: Draw on top: sun or moon icon at (4,3) (sun yellow, moon #86a3b8), 'DAY 3' in Silkscreen Bold at (16,5), time right-aligned at w-5. Track at y=14-16: blue night, yellow day, blue night (0-20%, 20-75%, 75-100% of the day). Now-marker: 1x5 bone line at x = 4 + (w-8) x day_fraction, y=13. Stretching breaks the track proportions, so redraw the track if you change width.

minimap_frame.where: HUD top-right, right under the clock (3px gap).
minimap_frame.notes: Map image in the 102x54 inside at (4,4). Player: bone arrow in the centre with a near-black outline. Zombies: 2x2 red #c1352d dots. Quest target: yellow diamond. North: 9x8 near-black notch at top centre with 'N'. Area name bottom-right in Silkscreen.

keycap.use: Key hints: interaction prompts ([E] Pick up), control hints along the window bottom, [ESC] Close.
keycap.where: Prompts float next to the target object; hints sit along the window bottom.
keycap.notes: Width = label width + 6. Label: Silkscreen Bold, near-black, at (3,2). Pair it with a panel_plate label to its right, 2px gap.

checkbox_off.notes: checkbox_on is 10 tall because the tick pokes 1px above the box: draw it 1px higher. Label 12px to the right.

checkbox_on.notes: checkbox_on is 10 tall because the tick pokes 1px above the box: draw it 1px higher. Label 12px to the right.

toggle_off.notes: Label under or beside it; yellow 'LIT' when on.

toggle_on.notes: Label under or beside it; yellow 'LIT' when on.

scrollbar_track.where: Right edge inside the list's inset.

scrollbar_thumb.notes: Height = track height x visible fraction.

flow_arrow_empty.where: Campfire station, either side of the fire.
flow_arrow_empty.notes: Progress: draw empty, then draw full clipped to progress x 20px from the left.

flow_arrow_full.where: Campfire station, either side of the fire.
flow_arrow_full.notes: Progress: draw empty, then draw full clipped to progress x 20px from the left.

icon_pack.use: backpack, all-items filter, back slot ghost
